changelog:
A power cut while a recording is being finalized or backed up off-site no longer loses that footage.
Playback and clip downloads on the local network now work on recorders with no internet gateway, such as an isolated camera network.
A full drive no longer shows every camera as having no video.
Disabling a user or removing their remote access now takes effect even while the Site Manager is unreachable.
A brief Site Manager outage no longer signs everyone out.
Relinking a recorder to the Site Manager now recovers by itself if the connection drops partway through.
Adding several ONVIF cameras at once is faster and lists the ones that timed out.
Schedule edits take effect immediately.
The Site Manager's sign-in, sign-up, password reset and invite pages now show each step on its own screen.
